# The per-commit tests that still write a sleep over one second or a deadline
# between five and thirty seconds (internal/ci/slowwaits_class_test.go), one
# `path:Func <reason>` per line. Every entry was measured on the day the rule
# landed (2026-09-25, hetzner, dev 64b9bec48) and none of them pays its wait:
# the deadline is a ceiling the run ends long before, or the sleep is a child's
# hang that a short bound kills. A test that WAITS a deadline out goes behind
# //go:build slow instead (the 26 moved that day are in the slow_test.go files
# beside them). The list only shrinks: an entry with no hit left is a red run.
